item.title: Incarico post-doc: The Unconscious in Theories of Language: Between Phenomenology and Psychoanalysis (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Rome
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PHIL-04 Estetica e filosofia dei linguaggi

Taking as its starting point the fundamental historical and theoretical problems within 20th-century philosophy of language, this project aims to investigate the relationships between French phenomenology and the theory of language—as well as between linguistics and philosophy—incorporating insights from Freudian psychoanalysis. The researcher will focus primarily on the concept of the unconscious, with particular attention to the relationship between language, perceptual processes, praxis, and the institutions of meaning.

item.description:

Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/HIST-03 Storia contemporanea

The project reconstructs Odesa’s history from the late eighteenth to the early twentieth century through critical analysis of international scholarship and especially French language sources, examining changing cultural and political understandings of its historical, artistic and environmental heritage. The role requires advanced historical expertise, methodological autonomy and scientific leadership. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Historical and Documentary Research on the City of Odesa in Support of the Protection and Enhancement of Cultural and Environmental Heritage (Univ. PERUGIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/HIST-03 Storia contemporanea

The project reconstructs Odesa’s history from the late eighteenth to the early twentieth century to support urban heritage protection and enhancement in line with UNESCO recommendations and the Historic Urban Landscape approach. Drawing on international scholarship and French-language sources, it examines the city’s historical, social and cultural transformations and its multiethnic character. Following the research group’s methodological guidance, the researcher will assist in collecting, organising and digitising historical sources, creating and analysing datasets, including with digital and AI tools, and preparing documentation for the project’s Scientific and Technological Guidelines

item.title: Incarico post-doc: PROJECT BEYOND DIFFERENCES: TOWARDS A WELCOMING ECOSYSTEM AT THE UNIVERSITY OF FOGGIA. UNIVERSITY PROJECT (Univ. FOGGIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-13 23:59
Institution: Univ. FOGGIA, Foggia
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-01 Psicologia generale, neuropsicologia e neuroscienze cognitive, psicometria

Often, latent neuropsychological vulnerabilities or undiagnosed neurodevelopmental disorders lead to academic failure. The project proposes a computerized screening to promptly identify at-risk individuals and direct them toward empowerment pathways or specialist evaluations. The system will ensure the early detection of difficulties in attention, memory, executive functions, comprehension, reading, writing, calculation, performance anxiety, and effort/performance discrepancies. The selected candidate will create testing materials and analyze the collected data.

The research focuses on psychological well-being and on identity-construction and gender-affirmation processes in transgender and non-binary people, within a clinical and dynamic framework. Activities include literature review, data collection and analysis using qualitative and mixed-methods approaches (semi-structured interviews, focus groups), and the study of the subjective experience of gender dysphoria and of minority stress, together with their implications for affirmative clinical practice. Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-02 Psicologia dello sviluppo e dell'educazione

The research project aims to investigate the development of social understanding skills, with particular reference to Theory of Mind, and future-oriented thinking in preschool children aged 3 to 5 years. To this end, the project will examine the role of various social and cognitive correlates potentially involved in the development of these competencies. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-04 Psicologia clinica e psicologia dinamica

The project aims to investigate feeding and eating disorders (FED) by integrating clinical and diagnostic assessment with empirical research on the effectiveness of psychological and integrated treatments. The activities will include: clinical and psychodiagnostic evaluation using validated tools for personality, mental functioning, and symptomatology; collection and management of clinical and outcome data; statistical analyses of factors associated with treatment response; and contribution to the writing of scientific papers and dissemination of results within SSD PSIC-04/A, GSD 11/PSIC-04 – Clinical and Dynamic Psychology
